# Data

**Nothing in this folder is experimental data.** Apart from `inputs/`, every file is generated by `python run_all.py` from the model and fixed random seeds. Deleting `data/`, `figures/` and `outputs/` and re-running reproduces them exactly (the Octave files need the optional MATLAB/Octave run).

Units are SI unless a column name says otherwise: temperatures in K, flows in kg/s, speeds in rpm, power in W, energy in kWh per 1800 s batch. `P(pass)` or `pass_frac` is the fraction of simulated batches with `T_L(1800 s) <= 355 K`. `ci_lo`/`ci_hi` are two-sided 95 % Wilson intervals; `lb95` is the one-sided 95 % Wilson lower bound. `m_cmd` is the commanded coolant flow; `mdot` in deterministic files is the delivered flow, equal to the command when no uncertainty is applied.

## Model inputs and assumed distributions — `inputs/`

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `parameters.csv` | Every model parameter with its value, unit and classification: carried over from ESC113M, literature property value, case-study assumption, or needs calibration. |
| `uncertainty_model.csv` | The four uncertain inputs and their **assumed** distributions (U_ref, M_J, flow-loop error, T_0). |
| `datasets.csv` | The Monte Carlo data sets: seed, size, sensor-noise seed and single purpose (OPT optimisation, CAL calibration, VAL independent validation, VAL2 reserve, STRESS stress tests, SOBOL). VAL and VAL2 use final-release seeds never examined during development. |

## Simulation-generated results

### `deterministic/` (RK4, Δt = 1 s, no uncertainty)
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `case_comparison.csv` | Baseline (300 rpm, 0.20 kg/s), nominal optimum, v1 robust setting and V3 recommendation: U, UA, UA_eff, final and peak temperatures, time to 355 K, time constants, RK4 stability limit, powers, energy. |
| `temperature_profiles.csv` | T_L and T_J every 30 s for the same cases. |
| `energy_balance.csv` | First-law closure: liquid enthalpy loss, coolant outflow (Simpson), jacket storage, residuals (trapezoid and Simpson, J). |
| `reduced_order_model.csv` | Series-resistance quasi-steady model against the full model; `tau_jacket_over_tf` shows where it applies. |
| `equipment_and_process_checks.csv` | Indicative geometry, Reynolds numbers, power per volume, pressure drop, jacket gap, property ranges. Screening checks only. |

### `verification/`
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `timestep_convergence.csv` | RK4 error against the exact solution for Δt = 60 to 0.1 s, with observed order. |
| `python_vs_octave.csv` | Python against the MATLAB-syntax implementation run in GNU Octave. Deterministic rows must agree; Monte Carlo rows are independent estimates (different random generators). |
| `octave/*.csv` | Raw outputs written by `src/matlab/run_all_matlab.m`. |

### `sensitivity/`
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `local_sensitivity.csv` | One-at-a-time changes of T_L(1800 s): the v1 steps (±20 %, ±1 K) and ±1 standard deviation, at the baseline and at the recommended setting. Flow perturbations are saturated at the pump limit. |
| `sobol_indices.csv` | First-order and total Sobol indices with 95 % bootstrap intervals (N = 32,768 base samples, seed 20261113). |

### `monte_carlo/` (exact solution per sample; identical to RK4 within 1e-7 K)
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `flow_actuator_distribution.csv` | Delivered-flow statistics for commanded 0.40/0.45/0.50 kg/s under the saturated actuator, and the V2 unbounded model for comparison. |
| `designs_under_v3_model.csv` | Earlier and current designs evaluated on VAL (n = 200,000) under the corrected model. |
| `final_temperature_quantiles_VAL.csv` | 501 quantiles of T_L(1800 s) per design. This is a compact replacement for the raw sample arrays, which can be regenerated from the seeds. |
| `convergence_recommended_VAL.csv` | Running P(pass) and Wilson interval against the number of batches. |

### `optimization/`
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `nominal_optimum.csv` | Deterministic optimum: grid search and continuous refinement. |
| `operating_grid.csv` | T_L(1800 s) and energy on the 5 rpm × 0.005 kg/s grid (operating-window figure). |
| `chance_constrained_flow_scan.csv` | Lowest speed meeting the 95 % lower-bound rule at each commanded flow (OPT) and its expected energy. |
| `recommended_setpoint_audit_trail.csv` | Every stage from the OPT optimum to the validated recommendation. |
| `speed_screen_near_recommendation.csv` | Speeds ±15 rpm around the recommendation on OPT and VAL. |
| `reliability_energy_frontier.csv` | Minimum-energy designs for α = 50 % to 99 %, optimised on OPT and validated on VAL. |
| `pump_limit_relaxation_hypothetical.csv` | **Hypothetical** higher pump limits (pressure drop extrapolated). |

### `adaptive_policy/` (simulation only)
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `configuration_scan_CAL.csv` | Twelve (N1, t_obs) configurations with the calibrated margin, the rounded margin and CAL performance at the rounded margin; `selected` marks the chosen one. |
| `validation_summary.csv` | The single validation of the selected policy on VAL (calibrated margin, margin after the pre-declared rounding, pass rate with intervals, energy mean/median/P95/P99/max, speed-capped fraction, soft-sensor error). A second row would appear only if the policy had failed VAL and been modified. |
| `validation_quantiles.csv` | Quantiles of energy, phase-2 speed and final temperature for the validated policy. |
| `robustness_STRESS.csv` | Sensor-noise levels and a wrong speed exponent in the planner. |

### `model_form/` (structured scenarios, not probability distributions)
| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `exponent_scenarios.csv` | Weak / nominal / strong heat-transfer closures: fixed and adaptive pass rates, re-optimised design. |
| `exponent_grid_recommended_pass.csv` | Pass rate of the recommended setting over an (e_N, e_M) grid, with the physical admissibility flag. |
| `jacket_flow_pattern.csv` | Jacket split into 1–20 well-mixed cells (towards plug flow), RK4. |
| `jacket_inventory_isolated.csv` | Effect of M_J alone. This is an isolated thermal-inventory sensitivity, not a geometry study. |

## Processed outputs — `../outputs/`
`summary_results.csv` (headline metrics with their source file), `validation_results.csv` (every independent validation performed), `run_metadata.json` (software versions, seeds, sample sizes, acceptance rule) and `octave_run_log.txt` (console output of the Octave run that the cross-check parses).
